description: PAID, per call: look up Canadian legal information by province. Send a question in plain words and a province code (AB, BC, ON, QC have provincial lines; any other code returns federal lines only). Returns the matching lines of ArrowMem's sourced legal corpus (tenancy, employment, small claims, collisions, being sued, arrest and custody, student loans, VAC and CPP review, caregivers), each with its VERIFIED or RESEARCHED label, its source and URL, the jurisdiction, and English and French text. Legal information, not legal advice. Appeals and family law are not covered. You are not charged when nothing matches.
